thesis: Bounded software and protocol analysis is the proposed first domain because properties and executions can be controlled.
role: Translate the mechanism into a falsifiable application.

ideas.statement: Bounded software and protocol analysis is the proposed first domain because properties and executions can be controlled.
ideas.recurrenceCandidate: Translate the mechanism into a falsifiable application.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: An invariant must hold initially, be preserved and imply the target; a protocol version change should preserve reproducible older results.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Fixed-library selection may supply the entire advantage, and first adoption should be advisory under clear specifications.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
